points.point: Why New post opens a chat instead of the tutorial's buttons
points.sentence: The chat IS the starting point -- the AI Agent creates your posts from what you type.

points.point: Where is the add video button (add media to a post)
points.sentence: To add media to a post: open the draft and click Photo / Video.

points.point: Where the AI image button from the tutorial is
points.sentence: To generate AI images, carousels, or videos: go to Videos, click "Create New Video," and pick a template.

verdict.reason: This entry answers all three points: the chat is the starting point, media is added via Photo / Video on the draft, and AI images are made from the Videos section.
